name: threadwake
description: Navigate long-running agent work as one canonical workgraph.

interface.shortDescription: Navigate long-running agent work as one workgraph.
interface.longDescription: Threadwake adds guidance for inspecting lifecycle, evidence, provenance, rejected paths, and next-action context without creating a second source of truth.
defaultPrompt: Explain this workgraph and what needs attention.
Trace the evidence and rejected paths for this work.
Prepare the context the next action should inherit.
